body.p: Jay. Once a man killed a jay. He brought it home, to his wife and said: "Pluck the bird." The woman took it, put it near the sacred pole, and said: "What kind of meat does a jay have." For a long time, the meat of the jay lay there. Eventually it got wormy. The man went hunting again. Not a single animal, not a single bird could be obtained. There is no luck, and there is no meat. One day a jay flew in and sat down on the edge of the tent. The wife says to her husband: "Kill the jay, shoot it. I'll cook soup for the child. Our child did not eat. And the jay heard this, sat on the top of the tent. It spoke in a human voice: "When the sledges for food were full, they didn't want the jay meat." They were proud. What happened now? It took off from there. And he says: "I do so with such people." And flew away. The husband says: "I fed the meat of the jay to the worms, so I lost my luck." The moral is this: Everything that the husband brought, process, do not let it rot. And then luck will not come to her husband. Num will look at you with a bad eye.
